title: The Resonance of the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact
next_chapter_hook: As the blurry figure gradually dissipated, a voice so familiar it made Chen Ji's heart stop suddenly echoed slowly from within the Turtle Shell—

text.content: As that voice issued an invitation, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand tremble violently—as if responding to some ancient summoning. Yet in the next moment, a scorching pain suddenly erupted at his chest, as if something long sealed was awakening.

Chen Ji tore open his robe fiercely, and there, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact he had kept close for over a decade was radiating a ghostly blue glow, ancient patterns flowing like living things across its surface, emanating a might far beyond his comprehension. That was the scent of the Celestial Realm—pure, ancient, beyond description.

dialogue.content: The Turtle Shell's aura... has resonated with this place. Boy, just who is your father?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled for the first time, his wisp-like form emerging from the book pages yet不敢靠近龟壳，仿佛面对着某种禁忌之物。他看着陈机的眼神变得复杂无比，既有对真相的渴望，也有深藏的恐惧。

Chen Ji did not answer; his attention was entirely captured by the Turtle Shell's transformation. The patterns on its surface began spinning frantically, gradually converging into a complex formation diagram, and at its center was赫然是一个残缺的「轴」字——与天机录封面上那个被他一直忽略的符号如出一辙。

The Axis of Destiny... that is the celestial realm's core hub! The legendary supreme divine artifact capable of manipulating the causal threads of all realms and regulating heavenly fortune! Mo Xiansheng's voice grew sharp, how could your father possess its fragment? Even the Eyes of Heavenly Way have coveted this treasure for ten thousand years!

Before the words even faded, the Turtle Shell suddenly erupted with blinding azure light, a majestic force surging forth like a tide, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. He felt his body transform into a vessel, being灌注 with some transcendent existence, his meridians screaming in protest.

choice.prompt: The Turtle Shell Divine Artifact's resonance grew increasingly intense; Chen Ji's body began unable to withstand this power influx. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Abandon resistance and let the Turtle Shell's power flow freely; perhaps gain more information from the resonance, but also risk being consumed by the force.
choices.risk_hint: Extremely High Risk of Power Loss of Control

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and abandoned resistance. The Turtle Shell's power rushed into his meridians like a breached dam's flood, pain almost tearing apart his consciousness, yet he clutched that thread of clarity desperately, for he knew this might be the only chance to understand his father.

choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to find the correct current within the resonance's torrent, directing the power toward a specific direction, transforming passivity into initiative.
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record May Be Disrupted by Resonance

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully activated the Tianji Record; the symbols on the fragment responded across the distance with the formation diagram on the Turtle Shell, constructing a stable channel within his divine consciousness. He felt like a helmsman standing at the confluence of two rivers—dangerous, yet able to control the direction.

choices.description: Use the Tianqing Sect's foundational techniques to forcibly suppress the Turtle Shell's resonance, sacrificing this opportunity but ensuring personal safety.
choices.risk_hint: May Forever Lose the Chance to Interpret the Turtle Shell

text.content: Chen Ji's expression darkened; his palm pressed against the Turtle Shell as he mobilized all his True Qi for suppression. The Turtle Shell's glow flickered violently but gradually收敛 under his will. His father's belongings—he would never let them be destroyed in失控.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the resonance's aftermath showed him a shocking vision—a chaotic void, countless light points weaving a web within the emptiness, and at the web's center, a massive axis slowly turning, pulling all causal threads.

dialogue.content: This is... the Axis of Destiny's本体 projection! Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled, boy, your father was no ordinary person—he was a person chosen by the Axis of Destiny! Just as you are now chosen by the Tianji Record!

text.content: Just then, the vision shifted; Chen Ji saw a familiar figure—his father, young father standing before an enormous gate, Turtle Shell Divine Artifact in hand, his expression identical to Chen Ji's current state: both reverence for the unknown and longing for truth.

Father's figure raised his hand, carving a string of symbols in the void; the symbols drifted slowly toward Chen Ji, carrying a tender yet sorrowful aura. A transmission spanning time and space, carrying a father's deepest love and regret for his son.

choice.prompt: Father's message is being transmitted, but the resonance is about to dissipate—Chen Ji must decide how to receive this legacy—

choices.description: Accept father's message entirely, possibly including his complete mission as a chess piece, along with those harsh truths he might not want to know.

text.content: Chen Ji spread his arms wide, welcoming those symbols without reservation. Information flooded into his mind like a deluge—father's life, his struggles, his arrangements, his expectations for Chen Ji—all poured forth in this moment.

choices.memory_label: 陈机了解了父亲的完整计划

choices.description: Only receive information related to Chen Nian, filtering out other content that might interfere, maintaining current mental stability.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Rationality, Obtain Most Critical Information

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath; with the Tianji Record's assistance, he established an information filtering barrier. Content about the grand scheme of heaven and earth was temporarily stored away, leaving only sections related to his sister. In an instant, his heartbeat nearly stopped—Chen Nian's whereabouts, right before his eyes!

choices.memory_label: 陈机获得了陈念位置的线索

text.content: As the transmission concluded, the patterns on the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact gradually dimmed, but the 「轴」 character symbol grew increasingly distinct, eventually solidifying into an eternal mark. Chen Ji knew—this Turtle Shell had become completely bound with his destiny, never to be separated.

However, what truly shocked Chen Ji's spirit was a name repeatedly appearing in the information—「Heavenly Fate Lock Key」. That was precisely the Holy Sect's designation for Chen Nian. Father explicitly stated in the information: Chen Nian was not taken by the Holy Sect, but rather was 「sent」 there, to fulfill some transcendent mission.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Key... so that's how it is! Mo Xiansheng's voice grew complex, your father is a candidate for the Axis of Destiny, and your sister is the key to opening that door. Your fates have been woven together since birth.

text.content: Chen Ji tightly gripped the Turtle Shell, his knuckles white from exertion. His sister, the girl he swore to protect, had actually been bearing something for him all along. Father sending Chen Nian away—was he protecting her, or exploiting her? These questions gnawed at his heart like venomous snakes.

But Chen Ji quickly suppressed his emotional turmoil. Yes, he was angry; yes, he was grieving; but he understood more clearly that pointless冲动 at this moment served no purpose. Father had schemed for ten thousand years; his ambitions必然深远. What he needed was not questioning, but understanding—then transcending.

Just then, a violent tremor suddenly came from the depths of the celestial realm, the air permeated with a terrifying might that chilled the heart. Mo Xiansheng's expression changed drastically: not good, the Eyes of Heavenly Way have sensed the Axis of Destiny's aura—they've noticed us!

choice.prompt: The Eyes of Heavenly Way's gaze is about to descend; Chen Ji must make an immediate decision—

choices.description: Abandon the current location, immediately use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to find a safe retreat path, preserve strength for future plans.

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated not at all; the Tianji Record Fragment flipped rapidly, his foresight ability activating instantly. His figure turned into a phantom at its original location, vanishing into the celestial mists, leaving only a faint, barely perceptible trace.

choices.description: Utilize the Turtle Shell's newly awakened 「轴」 character symbol to conceal one's aura, gambling that the Eyes of Heavenly Way cannot lock onto him in the first moment.
choices.visible_cost: Consume the Turtle Shell's Sealed Energy
choices.visible_reward: May Deceive the Eyes of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: The Turtle Shell May Expose More Secrets

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the Turtle Shell against his chest, bellowing 「Hide」! The 「轴」 character symbol blazed suddenly; a profound fluctuation spread outward from him, concealing his aura, the Tianji Record's aura, even the Turtle Shell itself's aura—as if he had completely vanished from this world.

choices.description: Since already discovered, might as well take the initiative to strike, testing the Eyes of Heavenly Way's true strength, gathering intelligence for future decisive battles.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely High Risk, May Be Seriously Wounded
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Information About the Eyes of Heavenly Way's Weaknesses

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes; far from retreating, he raised the Turtle Shell high, allowing the 「轴」 character symbol's radiance to绽放肆意. You want to see? Then let you see enough!

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, when that transcendent gaze truly descended, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact underwent its final transformation. A blurry figure slowly emerged from the Turtle Shell—that outline... that aura... unmistakably resembling Chen Ji's memory of his father, yet carrying some etherealotherworldly quality.

Chen Ji's heart clenched tightly; for the first time in over a decade, his eye sockets felt a burning酸涩. The father he thought long dead, the existence he swore to surpass, now appeared before him in a way he never imagined possible.

That figure seemed wanting to say something, lips parting slightly, yet no sound emerged. But Chen Ji understood that mouth shape—three words, the three words deepest carved in his bloodline: 「Protect Her」. That was father's final testament left to him, also the mission he must complete in this lifetime.
